thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/31/2018: SFET, FB, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/31/2018: SFET, FB, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.01%
AAPL: +1.09%
IBM: +0.42%
CSCO: +0.89%
GOOG: +1.21%
Technology stocks were moving higher in pre-market trading Monday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Safe-T Group ( SFET ), which was surging by more than 47% after announcing that one of its systems integrators has obtained an order from a large Israeli beverage company for its software development environment and software-defined access products.
In other sector news:
(+) Facebook ( FB ) was gaining 1% after a The Washington Post reported that the government shutdown will force the Federal Trade Commission to suspend its investigation of the social media giant over alleged violations of a 2011 consent order to keep user information private.
(+) Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) was up more than 1% amid reports that a US district court has dismissed a lawsuit filed against Google by consumers who claimed the search engine's photo sharing and storage service violated their privacy.
